text:
arjun (PM): quick sync: Q3 hosted-api launch readiness — need final scope for chat/completions/embeddings/rerank. Finance pushed for ~30% unit-cost reduction target; several enterprise pilots require 99th p latency SLO and private endpoints for embeddings. proposed slices: (a) chat low-latency, (b) embeddings private endpoints, (c) rerank quality. thoughts?

maria (Eng): we can hit 99th for chat at ~512 tokens by enabling adaptive batching + prefix caching; that costs ~+12% infra if we keep current quantization. to reach ~30% cost reduction we need int8 quant + more aggressive batching -> tradeoff: small P50/P90 latency regressions for very short prompts.

sam (ML): rerank note: current listwise model has best ndcg but serving cost is high. pairwise distilled reranker reduces compute ~2x and latency ~35% but nDCG drops ~1.2-1.8 points. proposal: canary pairwise + eval on pilot datasets before roll.

leigh (Sales): customer signal: Acme & Nova want embeddings with private VPC endpoints, dims 1536 & 1024, and encryption + contractual SLA on throughput. they said embeddings privacy is the gating factor for the deals.

jordan (DevEx): docs/SDK impact: changing embeddings routing or endpoint shape requires SDK v2.0 bump and migration docs. small example migration snippet we should include in the PR:
```
// before
client.embed({model: 'embed-small', input: 'text'});
// after
client.embeddings.create({model: 'embed-1536', input: 'text'});
```
This is a one-sprint work item for doc + samples.

olivia (CS): pilot feedback from legal sector: rerank precision matters more than latency. they prefer the higher-quality model even if slower. worth surfacing to sales/pm.

maria (Eng): ops note: dedicated pools can absorb rerank compute spikes; hosted will need pricing tweaks if we expect sustained rerank at scale. rollout plan: canary 5%, monitor fail-rate and p99; auto-fallback to baseline model on error.

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: canary deployed hosted-models/rerank-distill-v1 -> 2024-07-09T14:12Z to canary-5%

arjun (PM): OKR alignment check: Obj A: reduce unit cost for hosted products by 20% (KR A.1 cost-per-1k tokens down 20%); Obj B: ship private embeddings GA with 99th latency SLO. recommended prioritization: 1) embeddings private endpoints (pilot revenue), 2) chat latency (platform stability + P99), 3) rerank A/B and quality improvements.

leigh (Sales): agree — embeddings private endpoints unlock two pilots this quarter. sales can commit conditional contracts if we hit MVP timeline.

sam (ML): implementation proposal: ship embeddings private endpoints MVP supporting dims 1024/1536, per-tenant routing and KMS encryption. follow-up GA will add multi-dim routing + bulk ingest optimizations. rerank path: run pairwise canary + detailed eval against customer truth sets.

arjun (PM): action items: maria - perf plan + infra cost estimate (numbers for int8 vs current) by Wed EOD; jordan - SDK migration PR + sample snippets and changelog by end of sprint; sam - run rerank distill A/B and post evaluation results to this thread; leigh/olivia - lock pilot commitments and collect required SLA language. reconvene Thurs 09:00 for go/no-go. :thumbsup:

maria (Eng): acknowledged, will post a short perf doc with metrics and ci benchmarks before Wed.

jordan (DevEx): will open SDK PR today and flag breaking changes in CHANGELOG.

olivia (CS): I'll start outreach to Acme & Nova and get their exact throughput/ingest profiles.

leigh (Sales): adding timeline to CRM and prepping conditional SOW language.
